mapper.select: select max(if(ts.stat_type = '0701',ts.stat_num,0)) playStatNum, max(if(ts.stat_type = '0702',ts.stat_num,0)) collectStatNum, max(if(ts.stat_type = '0703',ts.stat_num,0)) praiseStatNum, max(if(ts.stat_type = '0704',ts.stat_num,0)) commentStatNum from track_stat ts where ts.track_id = #{trackId} and ts.is_deleted = 0 group by ts.track_id
